intent: A Context record rests only on sources that do not move when a package is added, so routine layout work does not turn a reviewed record stale.
actor: A developer adding a Go package under apps/platform/internal
observable_outcome: Adding a package changes no Registry source, so no machine check goes red and no human re-confirmation is needed.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Every reviewed Context record cites exactly the doc comment of the package that holds it, and nothing else.
The architecture identity file is not in the Registry's source corpus, so editing it leaves verify-sources current.
No two Contexts claim the same implementation path or a path inside another's.
